titles.native: 劇場版総集編 オーバーロード 漆黒の英雄

description:
A compilation film recapping the second half of the Overlord anime's first season, with a few extended scenes.

Embracing his new identity and power as the fearsome overlord Ains Ooal Gown, Momonga continues to navigate the world of Yggdrasil in his quest to bring Nazarick to a new realm of glory throughout the game world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
